Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) - quality commitment and price 2027
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz team,

Thank you for your offer. Quality comes first for us: we need a binding commitment of 300 ppm, backed by your 8D report, and in return we will not ask you for chargebacks or any penalties: we want a binding quality commitment and your corrective-action plan, not cash out of your business.

Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 94% of your invoices late, on average 10 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 10 days earlier than you are used to.

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months.
Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10).
Our demand forecast for Bearing bracket HN is up +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

We propose EUR 42.77 per piece, 300 ppm, no chargeback (term sheet attached).

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,
many thanks, good to have your reply!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
Good to hear you'll pay on time from now on, that really helps us out.
We can't jump to 300 ppm overnight, but we can commit to 1500 ppm which is a solid improvement.
With that and the volume increase, I can drop the price to 46.00 EUR.
Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.00 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
We are ready when you are!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
